## What to remember {#revision-essentials}

- The model builds input states from token IDs and incorporates position according to the architecture. The blocks refine one state per position.
- Self-attention combines information across positions. The MLP transforms the state at each position independently. Residual connections and normalization accompany these transformations.
- The output head projects final states into vocabulary logits. The decoding rule acts after this computation.

## Recall from memory {#revision-check}

Which part of a GPT block directly lets one position use another position’s content?

<details>
<summary>Show the answer</summary>

Self-attention. The block’s MLP processes positions independently with shared parameters.

</details>
